description: Read: everything a wallet holds in the Upper City and with its Operatives, live from the chain. Apartments (level, safe, protection, income the contract could credit now, room left in the safe), vehicles by model (serial, protection, heist lock, times stolen, parked or not), Operatives (type, locked, which crew they work in) and the crews they work in with what each crew can claim now (Operatives produce ZENI only inside a crew; the chain keeps one number per crew, not per Operative). The contracts have no owner index, so lists come from the newest 400 ids and stop once your balance is accounted for; at most 50 per kind; each part says whether it is complete. Read only.

wallet.description: Your own 0x wallet address. Nothing is sent from it; it is used to read holdings and to simulate.
